notes: From Head to Toe is a participatory book where Eric Carle's animals demonstrate body movements and ask 'Can you do it?' The child responds 'I can do it!' Core vocabulary already includes 'I' and the fringe word 'can' supports the key repeating phrase. The 10 animals in the book (penguin, giraffe, buffalo, monkey, seal, gorilla, parrot, camel, donkey, elephant) are already present in activity_images so no new animal icons are needed. The fringe focuses on the body parts and movement verbs that are the real communicative content. 'clap', 'stomp', 'wiggle', 'bend', 'raise', and 'turn' are already in aac_extras so those PNGs exist. 'body', 'head', 'arms', 'legs', and 'can' will need to be sourced from the Boardmaker library.
